workshop_summary: Decision rights for Group vs. local assortment: core and local range, new listings and pricing.

decisions.decision: Group Category Management decides the core range and markets decide a local range of up to 20% of SKUs per category, reviewed after six months
New brands listed in more than one market go through the monthly Group range forum; single-market listings stay local

open_issues.issue: Who sets prices on the local range: Group Pricing or the markets
Who tells key suppliers about the centralisation

actions.action: Develop two options for pricing rights on the local range
Lead the technical work on a shared category tree
Get the category managers together to agree the category tree
Draft key messages for briefing the buyers
Write the RACI for listing to delisting
Decide who informs key suppliers and when

risks.risk: Suppliers lock in better terms with individual markets before the range forum is in place
Buyers fear becoming order-takers and disengage
Norwegian local brands get delisted and Norway loses customers

dependencies.dependent: New assortment decision rights going live
dependencies.depends_on: Shared category tree and one product data source
